other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes global aggregates across all time steps for a subject (e.g., mean score over all games) and uses them as features for every row, leaking future performance information into past predictions.

summary: The agent implements a solid relational feature engineering pipeline and uses an appropriate LightGBM regression model with cross-validation. However, it suffers from two critical leakage issues: failing to group by player 'nickname' during CV splitting (causing subject overlap) and computing global player aggregates that leak future information into past game predictions.
